Sara (Sales): Hey team — NovaMetrics POC goes live tomorrow 09:00 PST. They want a sustained inference load for a 2-hour run and a short stress test. Can we temporarily resize their Dedicated pool and add a burst window? Also need a scoped hosted API key for their engineers to smoke test integrations.

Dan (Eng): We can. What's the target tokens/sec and expected concurrency?

Sara (Sales): Target ~8k tokens/sec sustained, short peaks up to ~18k tokens/sec for ~5min bursts. They prefer <100ms p95 latency. Budget question: 48-hr reserved capacity vs burst credits — ballpark extra cost?

Dan (Eng): For those numbers I'd suggest increasing pool to roughly 4x the current instance count (A40-equivalent baseline). Autoscale: min=2, target=4, max=10. Burst credits: add 150k credits for the test window. CLI to apply quickly:
```
redwoodctl pools update --pool-id pool-novametrics-01 \n  --min-instances 2 --target-instances 4 --max-instances 10 \n  --burst-credits 150000 --burst-window 300s
```
This will keep steady throughput and allow the 5m peaks.

Lex (Runtime): Recommend pinning them to a quantized variant for the POC to hit latency targets. Also set KV-cache TTL to 60s for the test. If they use long context it may bump kernel choices.

Olivia (Legal): Quick flag — NovaMetrics indicated logs may contain customer PII. We need a scoped retention policy and confirm VPC/private-plane access is not required for this POC. If they insist on private, provisioning lead time is longer.

Jordan (CS): I can create the hosted API key with limited scopes and a 72-hr expiry. Will also add token-level usage alerts. Can we confirm the email list for key delivery?

Sara (Sales): Send to dev@novametrics.com + cto@novametrics.com. They requested elevated burst for tomorrow morning — can we queue this ASAP? 

Dan (Eng): Queued the pool update and burst config. If Deploy Bot reports success I'll post exact endpoints. Expect propagation ~6-8 minutes after apply.

Deploy Bot: Pool update job queued: job-id #987655, eta ~7m.

Dan (Eng): Job completed. New target=4, max=10, burst-credits=150000 applied. Monitoring: https://console.redwood.example/pools/pool-novametrics-01

Jordan (CS): Hosted API key created and DM'd to Sara. Scopes: generate/text, embeddings. Expires in 72h.

Sara (Sales): Amazing — thanks y'all. I'll confirm with NovaMetrics and run the integration smoke. Follow-up: if they want private plane for production, we'll open the formal SOW. :thumbsup:

Olivia (Legal): Noted. I'll prep the short PII handling addendum in case they escalate.

Lex (Runtime): Monitoring hooks added to the model route to watch latency regressions during burst. Will alert on >120ms p95.

Sara (Sales): Great — closing the loop.
